title: Welcome new customers by SMS
summary: When a customer signs up, text them a welcome message and add them to your customer list.
description: Gives your sign-up form or app a signed web address. Each new customer it sends (name and phone number) gets a welcome SMS from your business, and is added to your customer list in a Google Sheet at the same time. A sign-up sent twice is only welcomed once.

params.name: welcome_line
params.title: Welcome line
params.description: A line after the greeting, e.g. what to do next.
params.default: Reply to this number any time you need help.
params.example: Your first class is free this week!

params.name: path
params.title: Web address path
params.description: The path your sign-up form calls.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Customer list spreadsheet
params.description: The spreadsheet's id, from its link.

params.name: sheet_range
params.title: Sheet
params.description: The sheet and columns rows are added to.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

steps.name: Use your business name and welcome line
Welcome them and add them to the list
Add them to the customer list
